{"consolidated_memory":"**Component: cli/commands/deploy.py (developer tooling)**

**Recurring Problem: Hang on exit in the deploy command**
- Signal: Process finishes work but never returns
- Reproduction: Deploy the sample project and wait
- Stack: Python
- Test coverage: tests/cli/test_deploy.py

**Seven Separate Occasions with Different Root Causes:**

**Occasion 1 [2026-01-31]**
- Trigger: Appeared only after client had already retried once
- Root cause: Off-by-one in the slice bound
- Fix: Corrected the bound and added a property test (PR #2398, branch fix/hang-on-exit-1)
- Result: Error rate dropped from 3.7% to under 9 per ten thousand

**Occasion 2 [2026-04-02]**
- Trigger: Appeared only after rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: Floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: Moved the arithmetic to integer minor units (PR #3927, branch fix/hang-on-exit-2)
- Result: Cold start dropped 49%, to 748 ms

**Occasion 3 [2026-04-13]**
- Trigger: Only for payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: Serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Fix: Switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields (PR #4400, branch fix/hang-on-exit-3)
- Result: p99 latency fell from 3.8 s to 476 ms

**Occasion 4 [2026-05-23]**
- Trigger: Only on the staging read replica
- Root cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call (PR #4667, branch fix/hang-on-exit-4)
- Result: Alert stayed quiet for 58 consecutive days

**Occasion 5 [2026-05-25]**
- Trigger: Only for users sitting in a negative UTC offset
- Root cause: Cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction (PR #5028, branch fix/hang-on-exit-5)
- Result: Nightly rollup matched the source counts for 32 days running

**Occasion 6 [2026-07-12]**
- Trigger: Only for sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
- Root cause: Clock skew between the two hosts
- Fix: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock (PR #6373, branch fix/hang-on-exit-6)
- Result: Job finished in 48 minutes instead of 9 hours

**Occasion 7 [2026-07-17]**
- Trigger: Only for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity (PR #8621, branch fix/hang-on-exit-7)
- Result: Throughput rose 51%, to 627 requests per second"}
